definitions.B: Exists; target wiring and end-to-end verification required

features.needs: Typed stage, format, net quantity, ingredient list, directions, warnings, shade code/name/source; merchant editing/readback; deliberately allowlisted public Liquid projection
features.acceptance: Exact product/shade facts or explicit absence; no generated claims; wrong-site denial

features.needs: Reuse ordinary variants; expose bounded shade labels and codes; keep variant identity through cart/order
features.acceptance: Same display colour Rosewater/Pink Clay selects distinct IDs by keyboard, unavailable variant rejected, correct order snapshot

features.needs: Canonical paginated queries with allowlisted stage/format/shade/sort; filter-state recovery and actual result counts
features.acceptance: Clear one filter preserves others; counts/pagination match server; unknown facts not inferred

features.needs: Versioned aura artifact using existing section/card/layout mechanisms; fields survive editor save/readback; explicit style/additive/full switching
features.acceptance: Installed/preview/published artifact matches design; prior instance/releases preserved; recovery keeps draft

features.needs: Canonical server-cart, signed handoff and hosted checkout; actual quote/rate/payment eligibility; no theme money logic
features.acceptance: Server totals, stock races, retries/idempotency and mock/live distinction; all variants retained

features.needs: Canonical registration/verification/sign-in and safe destination; existing profile/order/address owners
features.acceptance: Positive own-buyer flows then cross-buyer/tenant denial; changes persist; session expiry retains safe context

features.needs: Same-site public independently priced product links
features.acceptance: Correct identities/stock/prices; omit absent recommendations; no bundle inventory claim

features.needs: Excluded; no medical or certification claim introduced

features.acceptance: No health quiz, clinical profiling or subscription control
